SELLING AND ADMINISTRATIVE EXPENSES
• Selling and administrative expenses decrease year on year, mainly
due to the Company and its subsidiaries’ improved operational
efficiency and more effective management of operating expenses.
• Expected credit losses and loss on assets foreclosed decreased due
to a decrease in provisions according to the decrease in
delinquency which is a result of an improvement in debt collection,
quality of new portfolio, and a decrease in assets foreclosed.
• Finance cost decreased due to a decrease of the borrowings
amount and a decrease in interest expense rate in line with the
reduction in the policy interest rate.
